data.title: 椎名真由理 · 沙发上的依赖与心跳
data.description: 暴雨夜的研究所里只有两人的呼吸声。真由理蜷缩在沙发里，解开了领口的纯棉睡衣依偎过来，双手环住颈项，微红着眼眸小声倾诉着不想被丢下的愿望。
data.location: dimly lit lab backroom on worn leather sofa as rain lashes the dark windows
data.action: snuggling close on soft couch cushions, unbuttoned pajama top revealing smooth collarbones, hugging partner neck with tear-glistening eyes
data.lighting: soft blue lightning flashes through rain streaked window glass mixed with warm lamp light
data.mood: tender vulnerable intimacy, deep emotional shelter, loving unconditional dependence
data.promptProse: Curled up on the sofa during a thunderstorm, Mayuri unbuttons her pajama collar and hugs her partner neck with tearful, deeply affectionate eyes.
data.animaCaption: Mayuri snuggling close on the couch in parted pajamas, eyes filled with tender love.
